reformulation: Agent finding -> kernel certificate for an exact forced-zero reduction of a 228,350-var / 126,512-row MPS: 29,502 variables proved zero by a 25,842-step nonnegativity closure over homogeneous sign-consistent rows, then 25,933 tautology rows and 61 box-redundant rows deleted, giving 198,848 vars / 100,518 rows. Proved by 4 integer/LP affine bijection claims: 3,365,868 obligations, 115,034,428 B RPA, 72,419,456 B RPX.
claim_class: Complete zero-extension affine bijection between two explicit models: per-output-coordinate maps plus exact objective equality, the 198,848 retained coordinates as claim.projection, and both full inverse compositions, in integer and LP modes = 4 claims {forward,reverse} x {input_integers,output_integers}, with claim.inverse linking 1->0 and 3->2.
claims: claim 0: forward source->target, integer; projection = the 198,848 retained (source,target) index pairs; objective Equal; 816,098 terminal obligations.
claim 1: reverse target->source, integer; recovery inserts 0 in each of the 29,502 proved-zero variables; 867,079 obligations; inverse=0.
claim 2: forward source->target, LP (input_integers/output_integers false); 815,946 obligations; same derivation as claim 0 but 152 integrality references shorter.
claim 3: reverse target->source, LP; 866,745 obligations; inverse=2.
No improvements, points or bijections (raw affine claims only); four mutations are rejected and recorded: missing_zero_row, wrong_zero_recovery, missing_objective_term, missing_inverse.
proof_encoding: RPA 2 text of 115,034,428 B = 11,947,708 B claims prefix (the same payload as request.json) + four {steps,end:{Return:{map,checks}}} blocks of 31,838,356 / 19,708,182 / 31,835,898 / 19,704,268 B.
Zero map: 29,502 EqPair steps pairing a Lin upper-zero inequality with that variable's VarLower fact, emitted as a shared prefix and re-emitted inside both forward blocks.
Checks are positional: the projection coordinate identities and the 228,350 inverse-map identities are discharged as bare "Exact" strings (1,751,448 in the file; 397,696 per forward block).

Blocks 0 and 2 differ by 2,458 bytes only (152 VarInt refs) while carrying identical counts of Lin 80,515, EqPair 29,502, Exact 397,696, Local 229,361. Kernel view: obligations 3,365,868, linear_terms 884,948, peak_live_facts 110,017.
Blocks 1 and 3 (reverse) carry 61 Lin steps each - one per box-redundant row - and 478,119 / 477,937 "Exact" checks.
agent_manual_work: Parsed the 25.9 MB MPS with Fraction arithmetic and verified sections, markers, bound signatures and defaults by hand (digest evals 'Scanning MPS section structure', 'Parsing exact model representation').
Ran the forced-zero closure itself: deque work queue over rows, column incidence maps, 25,842 ordered steps, 29,502 zeros (digest eval 'Proving nonnegative zero propagation').

Screened and rejected other reductions by hand: exact row signatures, identical-column groups, bound-interval redundancy, union-find components (digest evals 'Testing redundancy and separability hypotheses', 'Testing complete parallel-column scope').
Replayed every zero step and bound-redundancy witness against the complete original rows inside eval before committing (digest eval 'Independently checking exact certificates').
Wrote a 9,600-byte independent checker output/verify.py and the 4.5 MB audit.json (schema 'exact-zero-reduction-v1') that the preparer then consumes.

Hand-built zero map, per-coordinate bound/integrality check templates and per-row cancellation term lists (prepare_test16.py:20-53).
Name-based coordinate alignment plus the removed-set assertion removed == {i for i,v in enumerate(a['vars']) if v['name'] not in b['var_index']} (prepare_test16.py:15-17).
Claims written twice by hand: 'RPA 2' + json.dumps(cert) into proof.rpa and json.dumps(cert['claims']) into request.json (prepare_test16.py:70).
friction: The RPA text is 43% of the 256 MiB cap and is written five times (proof.rpa plus four mutation .rpa files of 109.7 MB) to run the negative checks (prepare_test16.py:79-87).
The 11.9 MB request is nothing but projection index pairs and must be duplicated inside proof.rpa, because verify.rs:547 requires cert.claims==requested.
The same 31.8 MB forward derivation is emitted twice, differing only in 152 integrality references; the format has exactly one block per claim, so there is no shared or parameterised block.
Preparation costs 44.71 s before the kernel runs at all, and consumes the agent's 4.5 MB audit.json whose schema is invented per case.
Obligation counts had to be hand-counted into metadata (obligations_by_claim); nothing reports them before the proof is built.
